quests.instruction: Which marked strip along the side of a road is reserved just for bicycles?
quests.hint: Think about the painted strip along the edge of the road with a picture of a bicycle on it.
quests.explanation: A bike lane is a marked strip for bicycles. Bike lanes keep cyclists safely separated from cars!
quests.funFact: Bike lanes are often painted a bright color, like green, to help drivers notice cyclists more easily!

quests.instruction: Which spot is where two roads cross and meet each other?
quests.hint: Think about the spot in the middle of town where two busy streets cross right over each other.
quests.explanation: An intersection is where two roads cross. Drivers must watch carefully and follow signals at an intersection!
quests.funFact: Traffic lights and stop signs both help keep drivers safe at a busy intersection!

quests.instruction: Which red, eight-sided sign tells every driver to come to a complete stop?
quests.hint: Think about the red sign shaped like an octagon that tells every single car to stop completely.
quests.explanation: A stop sign is a red, eight-sided sign meaning stop. Every driver must come to a complete stop at this sign!
quests.funFact: A stop sign has eight sides so that drivers can recognize its shape even from far away!

quests.instruction: Which sign shows the fastest number of miles or kilometers a driver may safely travel?
quests.hint: Think about the sign with a number on it, telling drivers exactly how fast they are allowed to go.
quests.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the fastest safe speed. Speed limit signs help keep everyone safe on the road!
quests.funFact: Speed limits are often lower near schools to help keep walking children extra safe!

quests.instruction: Which wide road lets cars drive fast with no traffic lights or stop signs at all?
quests.hint: Think about a very wide road where cars can drive fast without stopping at any lights.
quests.explanation: A freeway is a wide road with no traffic lights. Cars can drive fast and smoothly along a freeway!
quests.funFact: A freeway uses ramps instead of intersections, so cars never need to stop at a light!

quests.instruction: Which large road, common in many countries, connects cities and allows very fast driving?
quests.hint: Think about a big, fast road similar to a highway, a word used in many countries around the world.
quests.explanation: A motorway is a large road connecting cities. Motorways allow cars to travel quickly over long distances!
quests.funFact: Many countries use the word motorway for the same kind of big, fast road called a highway elsewhere!

quests.instruction: Which short paved path connects a house's garage to the street?
quests.hint: Think about the short path right outside your home where the family car is parked before a trip.
quests.explanation: A driveway is a short path connecting a garage to the street. Cars are parked on a driveway at home!
quests.funFact: A driveway gives a car a short, private path to travel between home and the street!

quests.instruction: Which raised edge separates the road from the sidewalk?
quests.hint: Think about the raised stone edge you step up onto when you leave the road and reach the sidewalk.
quests.explanation: A curb is a raised edge between the road and sidewalk. Curbs help keep cars from driving onto the sidewalk!
quests.funFact: Curbs are often painted a bright color to show drivers where parking is or is not allowed!

quests.instruction: Which strip of land or grass separates two directions of traffic on a busy road?
quests.hint: Think about the narrow strip in the middle of a wide road that keeps cars going one way apart from the other.
quests.explanation: A median is a strip separating two directions of traffic. Medians help keep cars traveling opposite ways apart!
quests.funFact: Some medians are planted with grass, trees, or flowers to make a road look beautiful!

quests.instruction: Which spot has gates and flashing lights to warn drivers when a train is coming through?
quests.hint: Think about the spot where a road crosses train tracks, with gates that lower when a train approaches.
quests.explanation: A railroad crossing is where a road crosses train tracks. Gates and lights warn drivers when a train is near!
quests.funFact: The flashing lights and gates at a railroad crossing help keep both drivers and trains safe!

quests.instruction: Which building stores and dispatches buses or trains before they begin their routes?
quests.hint: Think about the big building where a whole fleet of buses parks overnight before their morning routes.
quests.explanation: A depot is a building that stores buses or trains. Vehicles rest at a depot before starting their routes!
quests.funFact: A large depot can be home to dozens of buses or train cars resting between their trips!

quests.instruction: Which structure along the shore lets ships dock and workers load or unload cargo?
quests.hint: Think about a sturdy platform along the shore where ships tie up so workers can unload boxes and crates.
quests.explanation: A wharf is a structure along the shore for docking ships. Workers load and unload cargo right at a wharf!
quests.funFact: A busy wharf can have many ships docked side by side, all being loaded at the very same time!

quests.instruction: Which place has many docks where small boats and sailboats are kept?
quests.hint: Think about a place full of docks where lots of small sailboats and yachts are tied up together.
quests.explanation: A marina is a place with docks for small boats. Marinas keep sailboats and yachts safely tied up together!
quests.funFact: A marina often has fuel pumps and shops nearby to help boat owners get ready to sail!

quests.instruction: Which raised platform behind a store lets trucks easily load or unload boxes?
quests.hint: Think about the raised platform behind a big store where a delivery truck backs up to drop off boxes.
quests.explanation: A loading dock is a raised platform for loading trucks. Loading docks make it easy to move boxes on and off!
quests.funFact: A loading dock is built at the same height as a truck bed to make loading much easier!

quests.instruction: Which large roadside stop lets truckers rest, eat, and refuel during a long haul?
quests.hint: Think about a big roadside stop with parking for many trucks, where tired drivers can rest and eat.
quests.explanation: A truck stop is a roadside stop for truckers. Truckers rest, eat, and refuel their trucks at a truck stop!
quests.funFact: A busy truck stop can have parking spaces for over a hundred big trucks at once!

quests.instruction: Which large area has many tracks where train cars are sorted, stored, and connected together?
quests.hint: Think about a huge area covered in many tracks where train cars are lined up and connected together.
quests.explanation: A rail yard is a large area with many tracks for sorting trains. Train cars are connected together in a rail yard!
quests.funFact: Workers at a rail yard carefully connect the right train cars together to build a whole new train!

quests.instruction: Which paved surface is the part of a road where vehicles actually drive?
quests.hint: Think about the paved part of the road itself, not including the sidewalk beside it.
quests.explanation: A roadway is the paved surface where vehicles drive. The roadway is the main part of any road!
quests.funFact: A roadway is built with layers of strong material to hold up heavy cars and trucks every day!

quests.instruction: Which single marked strip of a road is meant for just one line of traffic?
quests.hint: Think about one single strip of a wide road, marked by painted lines, meant for just one row of cars.
quests.explanation: A lane is a single marked strip of a road. Wide roads can have several lanes side by side!
quests.funFact: Painted lines between lanes help drivers stay safely in their own row of traffic!

quests.instruction: Which narrow strip beside the road is where a driver can safely pull over in an emergency?
quests.hint: Think about the narrow strip along the edge of a highway where a car can safely stop if it breaks down.
quests.explanation: A shoulder is a narrow strip beside a road. Drivers can safely pull over onto the shoulder in an emergency!
quests.funFact: Pulling over onto the shoulder helps keep a stopped car safely out of the way of moving traffic!

quests.instruction: Which sloped road lets cars smoothly join or leave a busy highway?
quests.hint: Think about the curved, sloped road that lets a car smoothly merge onto a fast-moving highway.
quests.explanation: A ramp is a sloped road for joining or leaving a highway. Ramps help cars merge smoothly with fast traffic!
quests.funFact: A ramp curves gently so cars can speed up safely before joining a fast highway!

quests.instruction: Which spot lets cars switch smoothly between two different highways using several ramps?
quests.hint: Think about the big, looping spot where two huge highways cross, connected by many curving ramps.
quests.explanation: An interchange is where two highways connect using ramps. Interchanges help cars switch highways smoothly!
quests.funFact: Some huge interchanges have so many looping ramps that they look like a giant knot from above!

quests.instruction: Which tall building has many levels where cars can park indoors?
quests.hint: Think about a tall building with ramps inside, where cars drive up level after level to find a parking spot.
quests.explanation: A parking garage is a tall building for parking cars indoors. Parking garages have many levels of parking!
quests.funFact: A parking garage can fit far more cars in the same space than an outdoor parking lot!

quests.instruction: Which sturdy stand lets you lock your bicycle safely in place?
quests.hint: Think about the metal stand outside a school where you lock your bicycle safely before going inside.
quests.explanation: A bike rack is a sturdy stand for locking bicycles. Bike racks keep bicycles safe while you are away!
quests.funFact: A bike rack lets you lock your bicycle's frame and wheel so it cannot easily be taken!

quests.instruction: Which spot has plugs where electric cars stop to refill their battery?
quests.hint: Think about the spot with special plugs where an electric car parks to fill its battery back up.
quests.explanation: A charging station is a spot with plugs for electric cars. Electric cars stop here to refill their battery!
quests.funFact: More charging stations are being built every year to help power electric cars everywhere!

quests.instruction: Which spot along a route stops travelers briefly so they can be safely checked?
quests.hint: Think about a spot along a road or path where travelers stop for just a moment to be checked before continuing.
quests.explanation: A checkpoint is a spot where travelers are checked. Checkpoints help make sure everyone travels safely!
quests.funFact: Checkpoints often use friendly signs to help guide travelers exactly where to stop!

quests.instruction: Which raised road crosses safely over water or wet, marshy ground?
quests.hint: Think about a long, raised road built right across a shallow bay or marshy wetland.
quests.explanation: A causeway is a raised road crossing water or marshy ground. Causeways connect two areas across wet land!
quests.funFact: Some causeways stretch for many miles, connecting an island all the way to the mainland!

quests.instruction: Which wooden walkway runs along a beach for people to stroll on?
quests.hint: Think about the wooden path along a sandy beach where families stroll, eat ice cream, and enjoy the view.
quests.explanation: A boardwalk is a wooden walkway along a beach. People stroll, shop, and relax along a boardwalk!
quests.funFact: A boardwalk protects the sandy dunes below while still letting everyone enjoy a lovely beach walk!

quests.instruction: Which marked starting point begins a hiking path through nature?
quests.hint: Think about the sign and small parking area marking exactly where a hiking trail begins.
quests.explanation: A trailhead is the starting point of a hiking path. Hikers begin their walk right at the trailhead!
quests.funFact: A trailhead sign often shows a map of the whole trail before hikers set off on their walk!

quests.instruction: Which special bridge is built just to carry train tracks safely across a river or valley?
quests.hint: Think about a strong bridge built only for train tracks, carrying a train safely across a wide river.
quests.explanation: A rail bridge is a bridge built for train tracks. Rail bridges carry trains safely across rivers and valleys!
quests.funFact: A rail bridge must be built extra strong to hold up the heavy weight of a passing train!

quests.instruction: Which small raised bump in the road makes drivers slow down as they pass over it?
quests.hint: Think about the small, raised bump across a road near a school that makes every car slow right down.
quests.explanation: A speed bump is a small raised bump in a road. Speed bumps make drivers slow down to stay safe!
quests.funFact: Speed bumps are often placed near schools and parks to help keep everyone extra safe!
